name: Enhance Oration
body:
School illusion; Level bard 1, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one person
Duration 1 round +1 round/level
Saving Throw no; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell enhances the target’s voice, allowing the target to speak with sufficient volume to be heard clearly by all within a 300-foot radius, regardless of other background noise. The target may still choose to whisper or speak at a normal volume. This spell can be used in conjunction with bardic music effects. Silence spells or effects can still affect the target.
